description: Browse a schema's current merged entity rows, not per-run records. Requires editor; no LLM call. Returns identities, revision, last_record_id and optionally payload, with limit/offset pagination. Rejected entities have no row; purge_entity_state may also remove delivered rows. Server-side state does not prove the external replica has applied its deltas. Use get_record and list_database_syncs for delivery and rejection diagnostics. See enricher://docs/database-sync.

entity_type.description: Filter to one entity type (the response lists the types present).
entity_type.title: Entity Type

include_payload.description: Include each entity's current merged payload. Set false for a compact identity-only listing (keys, revision, last_record_id).
include_payload.title: Include Payload

name: list_entity_states
title: List entity states
